fusions.name: Sting Relay
fusions.desc: Looses 3 stinging packmates at once, spread apart out to 6 tiles; each deals 3 damage.

fusions.name: For the Hive
fusions.desc: A barbed bite that costs 5% of your maximum health; it deals 9 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Tireless Lope
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Hive Tempo
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
